correctness.rationale: The frozen Finding incorrectly attaches C4 x C2 to the ambient group (F5^*)^2 of order 16; that model is correct only for G of order 8. The complete repaired RESULT.md at /workspace/repairs/2/RESULT.md corrects the two statements explicitly without changing the scientific counts or proof. Reassessment: Cooper's Eq. (7.6) gives the plus/minus parametrizations at epsilon 9/5 respectively, and Beukers–Tsai–Ye Theorem 1.2 proves Conjecture 1.1(2) for these exact normalizations at every prime, in particular five. Direct eta-product expansion gives the five stated pairs. Four has multiplier (0,0); among words without four, strings using digit one but no four have first coordinate zero and signed second-coordinate excess 0^L-(-1)^L for L>=1. On remaining words, u has order four, v has order two and v is not a power of u, so the repaired group model gives eight distinct products and the multinomial formula. Character eigenvalues have squared magnitudes 9 and, nontrivially, 5 twice and 1 five times, giving the exact Parseval numerator; fixed dimension gives the sharp max rate. The empty word and all support/infinite-occurrence witnesses follow directly. Fresh replay: python3 -B /workspace/reviews/reproduce.py 2, 30 coefficients of each eta series by direct triangular extraction and histogram/Parseval L=0..24; it confirms the order-16 ambient group and order-8 subgroup. This finite corroboration does not replace the cited Lucas theorem or exact Fourier argument.

Conditioning on both being units avoids trivial mass concentration and reveals exact spectral equidistribution on a proper product subgroup with a demonstrably sharp rate. The repaired group typing clarifies the distinction on which this interpretation rests.
